description: This file defines an enumeration 'OutputFormat' used for specifying output formats (txt and srt) in a media processing context, including methods for formatting transcripts according to the selected output style.

methods.name: needsAudioTimeRange
methods.description: Computed property indicating whether the output format requires audio time ranges.

methods.name: text(for: maxLength:)
methods.description: Generates formatted text from an attributed string transcript depending on the output format (txt or srt).
